title: Real-life speaking
summary: Bring sounds, stress, linking and melody together.

watch.creator: The Asian American Foundation × Wong Fu Productions

sentences: Hi, I’m Alex, and I live near the river.
I work with a small team on new ideas.
Could you call me back this afternoon?
Today I would like to share three points.
Thanks for listening. Do you have any questions?

shadow.creator: The Asian American Foundation × Wong Fu Productions

selfCheck: Sound accuracy: my target vowels and consonants were clear.
Mouth shape and final sounds: I shaped each sound and finished important word endings.
Stress: I emphasized the right syllables and meaning words.
Connected speech: I linked words and reduced small words naturally.
Rhythm and chunking: I grouped ideas and placed pauses between them.
Intonation: my pitch matched statements, questions and emphasis.
